body:
FULL layers carry history-row IDs, but the mono selection helper also used them to address the much smaller candidate table before discarding the value. For the observed token 35 / row 316436 input, this read element 111234 from a 73728-element allocation.

Keep the candidate prefetch branch-free and bound its address to the current token's row with `index_plan.candidate_offset()`. Valid REINDEX columns retain their exact candidate slot; FULL and padding still retain their original selected row. The shared pure function is tested directly, replacing the AST/exec-based CPU harness. The helper documentation now describes the bounded speculative load and its overlap with top-k.

Validation on gfx950 with the existing AITER revision unchanged:

- 83 related CPU tests passed, including every live compact column for the first, middle and last test token and the original failing FULL input.
- 21 GPU helper cases passed with an unmapped guard after the candidate allocation, nonzero token-specific candidates, permuted page mappings, and mixed live/padding lanes.
- Compiled the real K2a build (`tokens=36`, `index_bound_max=1048576`, FP4, TP4) for both versions. The conditional version contains 48 candidate-load exec-mask branches, each with `s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)`; these branches are absent with the clamp. Both builds have zero private scratch / VGPR spills; this is not a claim that all register scheduling is identical.

Short REINDEX selection-stage A/B/C, median per launch (8192 inputs -> 512 winners per CTA, 12 alternating rounds, 100 launches per graph):

| Tokens | Original branch-free | Branch (`1da72c116`) | Fixed clamp | Branch vs original |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 36 | 10.255 us | 11.933 us | 10.223 us | +16.4% |
| 128 | 10.486 us | 12.130 us | 10.450 us | +15.7% |

The fixed version is within about 0.3% of the original branch-free version in these two cases; treat that as parity. This benchmark covers the selection/top-k subpath, not full K2a latency or end-to-end serving performance. No SA long test was run for this revision.

### 🏷️ CI Guide

**Runs automatically on every eligible PR before approval:**
- ✅ Pre Checkin: Black, Ruff, catalog schema validation, non-GPU unit tests

**Heavy model tests:**
- ✅ Run after the PR is approved and Pre Checkin passes
- ✅ Run immediately when an approval review is submitted
- ✅ Can be requested before approval with labels

| Label | Tests |
|-------|-------|
| `ci:full` | Run all heavy PR model tests: native ATOM, vLLM, and SGLang |
| `ci:atom` | Run native ATOM model accuracy tests |
| `ci:vllm` | Run ATOM vLLM OOT model accuracy tests |
| `ci:sglang` | Run ATOM SGLang model accuracy tests |

> Heavy jobs are skipped when the PR is not approved and no matching `ci:*` label is present.
> Add labels via the sidebar or `gh pr edit 2683 --add-label <label>`
